restart.description: Rules restarting services after a deploy when their triggers changed. Services that `compose up` already recreated or started are not restarted again.

services.description: Services to restart - all of the stack's services when empty

trigger_variables.description: Dotted variable paths, each segment a glob (e.g. stacks.mqtt.users, stacks.z2m.*), each must match at least one variable

trigger_files.description: Globs relative to the stack dir (** recurses), each must match at least one file
